items.question: Under which zodiac signs is travel to the eastern seat prohibited?
premises: The astrological periods of Leo, Sagittarius, and Aries are specified.
Travel to the eastern seat is the action under consideration.
The verse issues a prohibition regarding this travel during those periods.
items.inference: One should not go to the eastern seat when the sun is in Leo, Sagittarius, or Aries.
uncertainties: The exact identity or location of pūrvapīṭhaka is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: One should not go to the eastern seat when the sun is in Leo, Sagittarius, or Aries.
